The institutional investor held 61,441 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.40M, down from 74,329 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cim Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $920.46 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.58% or $1.09 during the last trading session, reaching $187.27. About 5.93 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending.
